newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mandela postpones visit to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Mandela postpones visit to Philippines.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela has postponed his visit to the Philippines, scheduled for October 17-18, for health reasons, the Department of Foreign Affairs said on Monday.
Mandela called President Fidel Ramos on Monday to convey his regrets and said he hoped he would be able to make the trip "in the near future," the department said in a statement.
A foreign affairs official said the African leader was suffering from a knee ailment.
